typescript.mode: Owning TypeScript 7 CLI only, with no compiler API imports
typescript.declarations: TypeScript 7 emitDeclarationOnly from the prepared TypeScript source. No declaration editing or source-template copying into dist.

svgSourceProducer.rule: Generate TSX intermediates from exact upstream SVG input, with upstream named exports, before TS7 checks and declarations. Preserve the public ReactComponent signature through the exact upstream src/icon.ts type, replacing its former declaration alias at the TypeScript source level. Change only source import specifiers ending in .svg to the matching generated .js basename. Reject collisions or unexpected export syntax. This replaces upstream's generated-declaration SVG alias patch without adding a compiler API binding.

runtimeProducer.emitter: catalog esbuild, bundle:false, ESM, es2022, automatic JSX
runtimeProducer.reactCompiler: Compile and use the exact retained upstream esbuild React compiler plugin; its target/configuration remain unchanged. Stable dependency API compatibility requires acceptance.
runtimeProducer.nodeImports: Preserve upstream's removal of node: prefixes through a source-load transform before emission.
runtimeProducer.layout: Preserve src-relative dist entrypoints, loader.cjs, styles and dist/client/package.json sideEffects:false.

patchProduction.owner: package-patch.mjs, called only by the explicit generator
patchProduction.format: Complete deterministic LF unified package patch against the integrity-verified published npm baseline, including physical manifest, all changed JS/declarations, additions and deletions
patchProduction.metadata: Keep the published manifest's non-retired metadata. Apply the exact canonical source edge retirement and existing stable compiler-runtime catalog binding; preserve public files/exports and license.
patchProduction.output: A patch, complete package inventories and sibling source provenance in an explicit new .build/nextra-stable-docs child. No active patch copy, overwrite, install, provider registration or root-manifest write.
patchProduction.promotion: Forbidden until two independent matching complete patch/output inventories, provider/content acceptance and real native hook/patch graph evidence exist.

typeScript6: No new TypeScript API consumer is introduced. This producer uses TS7 declarations directly. The existing exact tsup compatibility binding remains untouched.

kaTexConsumerSeams.api: rehype-katex selected by latex:true or renderer:katex
